titleEn: Count Vowel Substrings of a String
title: 统计字符串中的元音子字符串
summary: 统计只含元音且五种元音都至少出现一次的连续子字符串数量。
insight: 枚举起点，向右扩展；遇辅音立即停止，维护五位出现掩码，每当掩码全满就计一个。约束小且逻辑直接。
pitfalls: 相同内容不同位置分别计数

solutions.title: 枚举起点扩展元音掩码
solutions.idea: 逐起点统计所有以其开头的合法终点。
steps: right 扩展，辅音 break；设置位，mask==31 时 answer++

code.java: class Solution { private int bit(char value){return value=='a'?1:value=='e'?2:value=='i'?4:value=='o'?8:value=='u'?16:0;}public int countVowelSubstrings(String word){int answer=0;for(int left=0;left<word.length();left++){int mask=0;for(int right=left;right<word.length();right++){int value=bit(word.charAt(right));if(value==0)break;mask|=value;if(mask==31)answer++;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun bit(value:Char)=when(value){'a'->1;'e'->2;'i'->4;'o'->8;'u'->16;else->0};fun countVowelSubstrings(word:String):Int{var answer=0;for(left in word.indices){var mask=0;for(right in left until word.length){val value=bit(word[right]);if(value==0)break;mask=mask or value;if(mask==31)answer++}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int bit(char value){string vowels="aeiou";auto position=vowels.find(value);return position==string::npos?0:1<<position;}public: int countVowelSubstrings(string word){int answer=0;for(int left=0;left<(int)word.size();++left){int mask=0;for(int right=left;right<(int)word.size();++right){int value=bit(word[right]);if(!value)break;mask|=value;if(mask==31)++answer;}}return answer;} };
